proof_body:
by
  intro f U c hU hc hcU hf hg z hz
  have hconn : IsConnected U := ⟨⟨c, hcU⟩, hc⟩
  have h1 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => f z + (starRingEnd ℂ) (f z)) U := (hf.add hg).analyticOnNhd hU
  have h2 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => f z - (starRingEnd ℂ) (f z)) U := (hf.sub hg).analyticOnNhd hU
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := AnalyticOnNhd.eq_const_of_im_eq_const (c₀ := 0) h1 (fun x _ => by simp) hU hconn
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := AnalyticOnNhd.eq_const_of_re_eq_const (c₀ := 0) h2 (fun x _ => by simp) hU hconn
  have e : ∀ x ∈ U, f x = (A + B) / 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have a1 := hA x hx
    have a2 := hB x hx
    rw [← a1, ← a2]; ring
  rw [e z hz, e c hcU]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → c ∈ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => (starRingEnd ℂ) (f z)) U → ∀ z ∈ U, f z = f c
